```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

library(googlesheets4)
library(dplyr)

# 1. SETUP
gs4_deauth()
sheet_id <- "1reSknnI2NfaYGdCovLiXL7rgnjXCJjLsgrc5rQ39xyw" # Replace with your sheet ID
app_data <- read_sheet(sheet_id, sheet = "Apps")

# 2. CSS STYLING
cat('
<style>
  /* 1. THE ANCHOR KILLER - Removes hidden link icons from the app titles */
  .app-title a, 
  .app-title .anchorjs-link, 
  .app-title::after, 
  .app-title::before {
    display: none !important;
    visibility: hidden !important;
    content: none !important;
  }

  /* 2. GRID LAYOUT */
  .app-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr));
    gap: 25px;
    padding: 20px 0;
  }

  /* 3. CARD STYLING */
  .app-card {
    background: white;
    border-radius: 12px;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    height: 100%;
    border: 1px solid #eee;
  }

  .app-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); }

  .app-image-container {
    width: 100%;
    height: 200px;
    background-color: #f8f9fa;
    overflow: hidden;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;
  }

  .app-image {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    object-position: top;
  }

  .app-content {
    padding: 20px;
    flex-grow: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    text-align: center; /* Centering the text for a clean look */
  }

  .app-title { 
    font-size: 1.3rem; 
    font-weight: 700; 
    margin: 0 0 10px 0 !important; 
    color: #2c3e50;
    width: 100% !important;
  }

  .app-description { 
    font-size: 0.9rem; 
    color: #666; 
    margin-bottom: 20px; 
    flex-grow: 1; 
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  /* 4. BUTTON GROUP */
  .button-group {
    display: flex;
    gap: 10px;
    margin-top: auto;
  }

  .app-button {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 10px 5px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    text-align: center;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    text-decoration: none !important;
    transition: opacity 0.2s;
  }

  .btn-launch { background-color: #2c3e50; color: white !important; }
  .btn-github { background-color: #f1f3f5; color: #2c3e50 !important; border: 1px solid #dee2e6; }
  
  .app-button:hover { opacity: 0.8; }
</style>
')

# 3. GENERATE THE GRID
cat('<div class="app-grid">')

for(i in 1:nrow(app_data)) {
  app <- app_data[i, ]
  
  # Image Logic (Manual > MShot > Placeholder)
  img_src <- if(!is.na(app$Image)) {
    app$Image 
  } else if(!is.na(app$URL)) {
    paste0("https://s0.wp.com/mshots/v1/", URLencode(as.character(app$URL)), "?w=400")
  } else {
    "https://via.placeholder.com/400x250?text=No+Preview"
  }

  cat(paste0(
    '<div class="app-card">',
      '<div class="app-image-container">',
        '<img src="', img_src, '" class="app-image">',
      '</div>',
      '<div class="app-content">',
        '<h3 class="app-title">', app$Title, '</h3>',
        '<p class="app-description">', app$Description, '</p>',
        
        '<div class="button-group">',
          '<a href="', app$URL, '" target="_blank" class="app-button btn-launch">Launch App 🚀</a>',
          
          if(!is.na(app$GitHub)) {
            paste0('<a href="', app$GitHub, '" target="_blank" class="app-button btn-github">Source Code 💻</a>')
          } else { "" },
        '</div>',
        
      '</div>',
    '</div>'
  ))
}

cat('</div>')
```
